bridgeRouteRisk.summary: nOPAL has four reviewed independent native-issuance routes on Ethereum, Plume, BSC, and Plasma, plus reviewed LayerZero OFT representations on Solana, World Chain, and Avalanche. The issuer registry and current explorer records identify the exact deployments. Structured controls record the Solana OFT mint-authority/program-admin path and the World Chain/Avalanche owner-controlled bridge-mint, peer-configuration, and upgrade paths. Complete LayerZero DVN configuration, controller key custody, route limits, and recovery remain undisclosed. The Arc deployment is identity-verified, but its issuance and transfer classification and control ownership remain unresolved.
